_meta.description: Everything in Kern: three word games, eighteen living worlds, one fair par-based score, the Daily Kern, generated music, and a fully offline game with no ads.
a-bright-afternoon-that.f8b641: A bright afternoon that keeps time with your streak.
a-daily-ritual-that.146c5a: A daily ritual that respects your time — no server, no events, no strings.
a-pastel-meadow-hiding.634812: A pastel meadow hiding eggs the way grids hide words.
a-pause-that-hides.8f2e21: A pause that hides the board
a-word-search-with.108338: A word search with a twist: every hidden word belongs to the world you're in. An Ocean board hides ocean words.
amber-fields-felt-keys.fda0e7: Amber fields, felt keys, a slow golden hour.
bare-oaks-over-a.112572: Bare oaks over a frozen pond, skate lines in the ice.
blaine-miller-all-rights.b327c2: © Blaine Miller. All rights reserved.
bunting-on-the-poles.7ed4f1: Bunting on the poles, fireworks over the rooftops.
cool-current-steady-pulse.2046f1: Cool current, steady pulse, words that flow.
deep-water-patient-light.b23e2f: Deep water, patient light. Spell CORAL and the sea answers.
dictionary-puzzle-generation-scoring.fef: Dictionary, puzzle generation, scoring, worlds, and music all live on device. Airplane mode is a perfectly good place to play.
drag-any-path-through.e30752: Drag any path through neighboring letters and build your own words. The board hides more than you think.
dusk-under-old-growth.5499a4: Dusk under old growth — streaks wake the fireflies.
each-puzzle-gives-you.00a541: Each puzzle gives you three hints that show a word you can still find. Tap any word you've found to read its dictionary definition, offline.
every-puzzle-carries-a.4ff387: Every puzzle carries a computed par, and your score is your quality against par plus a speed bonus — the same formula in every mode, every world, every level. No theme or setting can buy points. That's what makes the daily leaderboard one competition instead of three.
every-session-composes-itself.fc32c9: Every session composes itself from the world's own recipe: letters walk the scale, a valid word resolves the chord. No two sessions sound alike.
every-world-has-its.9ec5a0: Every world has its own light, its own tiles, and its own generated music — and it listens. Long words pulse the board, streaks build the world's energy, and a word that belongs to the world earns its signature flourish.
felt-piano-and-old.5e5913: Felt piano and old paper. FOLIO earns a flourish.
from-first-ligature-to.dd76ed: From First Ligature to Em Dash to Full Bleed — and yes, playing a word with consecutive r-n in it unlocks one called Keming.
game-center-daily-boards.f94027: Game Center daily boards for each mode, plus a combined board that sums all three. Lifetime scores count in Ems — an em is type's own unit of measure.
gold-sparks-over-the.3a33f0: Gold sparks over the year's last letters.
hushed-snow-cold-blue.55872f: Hushed snow, cold blue light, a touch of red.
lake-light-a-long.ad1204: Lake light, a long dock, a sail on the horizon.
leaves-fall-harder-the.7ff17a: Leaves fall harder the longer your words get.
letterpress-tiles-and-ink.09f710: Letterpress tiles and ink — the type nerd's home turf.
no-accounts-no-ads.ed3960: No accounts, no ads, no analytics, no third-party SDKs. Puzzles, scoring, worlds, and music are all computed locally, and the whole game works offline. The only thing that ever leaves is a Game Center score you choose to post.
one-seeded-puzzle-per.324b7e: One seeded puzzle per mode per day — the same boards for everyone on Earth, computed on your device. No server involved, nothing to download.
pick-a-place-not.91b441: Pick a place, not a palette
purple-dark-pumpkin-light.ecc261: Purple dark, pumpkin light, something in the letters.
seasonal-worlds-join-the.9f8cd8: Seasonal worlds join the picker and the daily rotation on their own calendar — no downloads, no events to sign up for. They simply appear when their season does, and step back when it passes.
swipe-through-a-letter.2f2f6e: Swipe through a letter wheel to spell words that fill a mini crossword. Extra words bank as bonus finds.
the-blossom-tree-wakes.c4bd02: The blossom tree wakes, and sprout rows keep your pace.
the-pause-button-stops.81c118: The pause button stops the clock and covers the board, so a pause buys time, never thinking time. Kern also pauses itself when a call or notification pulls you away.
the-sky-burns-low.1463d4: The sky burns low, and long words send it deeper.
three-modes-eighteen-worlds.11fe5f: Three modes, eighteen worlds, one fair score, and the quiet details around them.
universal-in-every-orientation.d37717: Universal, in every orientation — Split View, Slide Over, and Stage Manager included. The board scales, the wheel re-anchors, nothing clips.
warm-stone-long-shadows.98c54b: Warm stone, long shadows, a scale you can't quite place.
wheel-search-and-chain.17083f: Wheel, Search, and Chain share a single par-based formula — so the daily leaderboard is one competition, not three.
word-list-based-on.2f832e: Word list based on the public-domain ENABLE list, locally curated.
